title: Cheesy {p} Skillet with {v}
steps: Dice the {s}. Cook in an oiled skillet, covered, stirring now and then, until golden and tender, about 10 to 12 minutes. Move to a plate.
Cook the {p} with the {v} in the same pan, breaking up the meat, until browned and {doneness}. Drain off extra fat.
Stir in the {spice} for a minute, then return the {s}.
Top with the {sauce}, cover, and cook until melted and bubbly, 2 to 3 minutes.
tip: Use lean meat, drain the fat, and go light on the cheese. Stir in extra vegetables.
